marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 谢沅瑾的现代聊斋 : 21则百分之百真实故事完整呈现, 教你化解厄運 | Xie Yuan Jin de xian dai liao zhai : 21 ze bai fen zhi bai zhen shi wan zheng cheng xian, jiao ni hua jie e yun

Have you ever thought that an unintentional action will bring you an unprecedented bloody crisis? What should you do when you accidentally enter your buddy's construction site and feel unwell? You think all these strange things happen just by coincidence, but you don't realize that they are all predetermined! Apart from being able to exorcise ghosts, you should also be able to prevent ghosts. This book provides the most practical tips on how to exorcise ghosts through case studies, so that you can learn how to avoid evils and good fortune while reading the stories!
